title: Quenched Smoky Spanish Cornmeal Tortilla
description: A savory and smoky Spanish dish featuring cornmeal, perfect for a hangover cure, with an umami flavor and flaky texture. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a splash of olive oil.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Add the egg mixture to the cornmeal mixture and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9-inch skillet or tortilla pan.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
